text:
Type: pair of patterned grommet curtains
Use: dressing windows and softening light; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, retro
Materials: woven cotton with a printed pattern, metal ring grommets
Colors: white, cobalt blue, navy, light blue, soft pink
Shape: two long straight panels on a rod with a grommet heading, vertical bands of dots, ovals and diamonds, regular soft folds, medium visual weight
Feel: cheerful, light, playful
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue or pink accents, grey sofas; Scandinavian or retro rooms

product.name: MOSSFLOX
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
